fields.title: Rebuild Narrate with the cursor attached to the playing word
fields.description: Path: epic. Phase 0 proves Kokoro (word table exact vs its own audio; start and speed change within 2 s), then a deterministic core: per-chunk exact word table + playback clock, cursor = word at the current playback sample, no estimated timing, no stretching. Finish line: Narration rebuilt.
fields.notes: origin: held plan 2026-10-11-narrate-rebuild (rebuild draft stub). Absorbed by roadmap review 2026-10-11 as Path: epic; /epic charters it when it reaches the head.
